methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional investment in peer-based AI fluency outside major metro hubs, directly signaling distributed capability-building through education rather than platform dependence.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free grassroots AI workshops led by a Norfolk native explicitly target the technology gap with community-driven skill transfer, indicating distributed deep learning efforts in a non-tech-hub region.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-AI Ready RVA partnership concentrates institutional AI education resources in the state capital, reinforcing Richmond as a secondary metro hub while leaving rural-metro knowledge transfer mechanisms undefined.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - axios.com
signals.signal_reading: Workforce pressure from AI platforms suggests Richmond's young workers face shallow adoption demands from employers deploying AI tools rather than building deep technical capability internally.

signals.title: Column: AI is reshaping Hampton Roads before our eyes - The Virginian-Pilot
signals.signal_reading: Commentary acknowledging AI's reshaping of Hampton Roads signals awareness of concentration dynamics in a defense-tech region, but lacks evidence of distributed capability-building beyond platform consumption.
